extension.summary: Watch live sports, 24/7 channels, and replays from Sportsurge & StreamEast
extension.description: Kodi add-on for Sportsurge & StreamEast. Features 24/7 live TV networks, full match replays with Real-Debrid / AllDebrid, StreamEast multi-source fallback (1080p 60fps), smart auto-play with live health check, and multi-tier stream resolution.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on does not host or distribute any video content. It merely parses publicly accessible web links.
